name: Farmer's Walk (Weighted)
instructions: Stand between two heavy dumbbells and pick them up by hinging at the hips with a flat back.
Stand tall with your shoulders pulled back and down, arms at your sides.
Walk with short controlled steps for a set distance or time.
Keep your core braced and avoid leaning to either side.
Set the weights down under control.
longevityNotes: Carrying is the most functional strength there is — groceries, luggage, a grandchild. Loaded carries build grip, posture, and core stability in one movement.
overview: A loaded carry holding heavy dumbbells at your sides that builds grip, upper back, core and overall stability.
